item.title: Buena Vista Social Club on Broadway — Battery-Free Luggage Scale
item.description:
How “Buena Vista Social Club” Brings Havana to Broadway—and Why a Mechanical, Battery‑Free Luggage Scale Belongs in Your Bag

The music starts with a tres guitar riff, and suddenly Havana’s salt-kissed air seems to drift into Midtown. “Buena Vista Social Club,” the landmark 1996 album that reintroduced a global audience to classic Cuban son and bolero, has stepped into a new spotlight: Broadway. This season, the musical inspired by that recording earned five Tony Awards, recognizing a production that pulses with heritage, romance, and the promise of second chances. Co-choreographers Justin Peck and Patricia Delgado—a creative partnership that’s also a marriage—spoke with CBS Mornings Plus about bringing their deeply personal connection to Cuban music onto the stage. The result feels less like a show and more like a journey: from the Malecón to Manhattan in a matter of measures.
